messages:
eli: hey — AcmeCorp reporting a big usage discrepancy. Dashboard UI sums ~2.1k tokens for a session but their invoice shows ~9.4k. Customer insists they only sent a short prompt + 1 short completion.
ryan: can you paste the raw request/headers and a curl repro? any system or tool messages included?
eli: posting quick curl we used to repro below. note the embedded analytics sidecar header we send from the client: 
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -H "X-Client-Sidecar: analytics-v1" \n  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are helpful."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the paragraph."}],"stream":false}'
```
eli: server logs for the same trace show extra internal function/tool call: `analytics_logger.log_event` injected by sidecar and a trailing function response.
maria: billing — please include invoice id and timeframe. quick FYI: our metering counts any server-injected system/tool messages and function call payloads that run during request processing. Some client SDK estimators don't include those.
eli: invoice id INV-2026-4237, timeframe Mar 10 03:12-03:14 UTC. I attached the trace id to the support ticket: trace=tr_0a1b2c3d.
ryan: looking at logs now — I can see the sidecar header triggers an internal pipeline step that calls our analytics function which includes the original prompt as part of its payload (so double-count). also streaming stop looks like client aborted but kernel finished last token generation, adding ~6k tokens.
eli: repro steps to trigger locally: 1) enable analytics header, 2) set stream=false, 3) send a ~40-token prompt. We saw the server-side tool call append an extra 4–7k tokens in the tool response body.
maria: that would explain the invoice delta. For hosted customers we charge based on server-side metering, which is working as designed — but we need clearer guidance and maybe a fix so analytics calls don't echo prompts into tool bodies.
ryan: tentative fix: strip prompt content from analytics payload and mark internal tool responses as metering-exempt for self-generated telemetry. I'll open a PR to avoid including prompt text and add a regression test.
eli: can we get an ETA? customer is asking for a bill correction if this was caused by our sidecar.
ryan: I'll have a hotfix branch today, tests + deploy by EOD tomorrow if no surprises. If billing needs to refund we'll need a verified repro and the exact trace ids.
maria: I'll hold off on automated adjustments until engineering confirms root cause. If confirmed, billing will issue a credit for the excess tokens for INV-2026-4237 and notify the customer.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: patch/analytics-strip-prompt -> staging (started) :rocket:
eli: thanks — attaching the minimal trace and curl to the ticket now.
ryan: heads-up for metering team: patch will change metering attribution; please review once PR link is up.
maria: noted. tagging metering@redwood for audit.
eli: customer replied saying they can pause charges if we confirm repro; I'll keep them updated. :eyes:
ryan: will ping when PR is merged.
maria: thanks all — moving to escalation queue if engineer confirms. :thumbsup:
